title: President Trump to Highlight Crackdown on Overseas Crypto Scams
summary: Bitcoin Magazine President Trump to Highlight Crackdown on Overseas Crypto Scams Trump to tout seizures of fraudulent crypto sites at White House cybercrime event as FBI data shows $11.3 billion in U.S. crypto fraud losses in 2025. This post President Trump to Highlight Crackdown on Overseas Crypto Scams first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
